subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this maintainer-authored prompt-guidance branch be closed as superseded by current main, or rebased into the current sub-agent prompt architecture?
rationale: The useful idea is largely represented on current main, but the protected maintainer label and prompt-policy surface require an owner to decide whether any remaining wording should survive.

options.title: Close as superseded after maintainer check
options.body: Current main already has richer sub-agent orchestration and tool-description guidance, so close this branch if no unique policy remains.

options.title: Rebase and consolidate
options.body: Keep the PR only if the desired wording is folded into existing helpers and the duplicate Tooling rubric is removed.

options.title: Defer to Codex-specific guardrail work
options.body: Leave generic core prompt policy alone and handle Codex app-server steering in the narrower related Codex PR if maintainers still want that behavior.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded after maintainer check
recommendation.body: Current main already has richer sub-agent orchestration and tool-description guidance, so close this branch if no unique policy remains.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the current prompt-policy direction and already stated a product view on the related per-agent tool-policy proposal.
